components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail

      properties:
        type:

          format: uri

          title: Title

          readOnly: true
        status:

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
